list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four Gd(III) ions and six bridging chloride ions form a discrete defect-dicubane {Gd4Cl6} core. The two crystallographically distinct Gd sites are seven-coordinate with distorted pentagonal-bipyramidal geometries. Coordinated methanol and hydroxide complete the cation; uncoordinated chloride and methanol occur between clusters.

synthesis.procedure: A solution of GdCl3·6H2O (0.1 mmol) in methanol (5 mL) was combined with a solution of H2L (0.0632 g, 0.2 mmol) in CH2Cl2 (25 mL). The mixture was stirred for 4 hours at ambient temperature and filtered.
